summary.text: Gabriel Sanchez, a Democrat from Smyrna, was first elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 2024 and was sworn in on January 13, 2025; he represents District 42, which includes a portion of Cobb County.

paragraphs.text: According to the campaign website, Sanchez was born and raised in Cobb County to Colombian immigrants, lives in Smyrna, and is a long-time community organizer.

sources.title: Rep. Gabriel Sanchez Sworn in, Receives Committee Assignments for the 2025-2026 Legislative Term
